Privacy Policy
Last Updated: November 25, 2024
Thank you for using Proxima Beta's (as defined below) products and services! We respect your concerns about privacy and appreciate your trust and confidence in us.

Here is a summary of the information contained in this privacy policy. This summary is to help you navigate the privacy policy and it is not a substitute for reading everything! You can use the hyperlinks below to jump directly to particular sections.
What information do we need to provide the Game Services?

If you register an account to use the Game then we will need some information from you to set this up. We will also process some information when you use the Game (e.g., to make sure your progress is saved) and when you buy items (e.g., to ensure you get the purchased content). If you choose to set up your Game profile using a social media account, we also collect information from that social media account. If you choose, you can provide certain other information to personalise the gaming experience and enable Game features, or participate in Game Services. If you choose to use the eSports Website, we will need your Game login credentials and other information, such as your email address, user and account information, and information to enable you to form or join teams and participate in eSport competitions for the Game. If you need to get in touch with us then we will also retain some information so that we can get back in touch with you and address any concerns. More Information.
How will we use your information?

We use your information to provide the many functions and services that comprise the Game Services. We also use your information for account verification, security purposes, to support and improve the Game Services, to process transactions as part of the Game Services, to provide you with game updates, and to enforce our terms, conditions and policies. We do not disclose your information to any third parties, except where we need to in order to provide the Game Services (e.g., use local cloud providers or to back up your data; using our affiliates around the world to help us to deliver the Game Services) or monitor the success of our marketing and advertising programs, or where we are instructed to by a court, authority or compelled by law. More Information.
Who do we disclose your information to?

We use some third parties to help us deliver the best possible experience (e.g., cloud services to back up your data, support ticketing and fraud detection). When we use a third party, we only do this to process or store your information for the purposes described in this privacy policy. We also have affiliates around the world who help us deliver the Game Services and we may be required by a court or legal obligation to disclose certain information in some circumstances. More Information.
Where do we process your information?

Our servers are located in Russia (in the case of users located in Russia only) and Singapore. Your information can be accessed from outside of where you live by our support, engineering and other teams around the world, including Singapore, the People's Republic of China, Egypt, Turkiye, Malaysia, Brazil and Mexico. More Information.
How long do we keep hold of your information?

We generally retain your information for the period during which you maintain an account for this Game after which time your data is deleted (as further described in this privacy policy), unless otherwise required by applicable laws. More Information.
How can I exercise my rights over my information?

Depending on where you live, you may have certain rights with respect to your information, such as rights of access, to receive a copy of your data, or to delete your data or restrict or object to our processing of your data. More Information.
How to get in touch with us
If you have any questions about anything in this policy, or want to exercise any rights you may have, please contact us here.
How will we notify you of changes?
If there are any significant changes to this privacy policy, we will update the policy here. More Information.

The Types of Personal Information We Use

This section describes the different types of personal information we collect from you and how we collect it. If you would like to know more about specific types of data and how we use that data, please see the section entitled "How We Use Your Personal Information" below.

For certain regions, you may also be asked to provide us with your date of birth (stored device-side only) to verify your age and for administration of the gameplay management system. If you are located in certain regions, we may ask you to provide an email address for the purpose of verifying parental or guardian consent to use the Game services if you are under the relevant minimum age. You also provide us with information when you set up your profile for the Game (including region location and information you voluntarily elect to provide in order to customise gameplay or Game Services, such as gender or photos you upload to your in-Game photo wall) or your nickname when you log-in as a 'guest' in order to use the Game.

Once a Game account is set up, you may also choose to provide us with your mobile phone number or email address and a password, which you may select yourself for these purposes. These will be bound to your account (once verified by way of a verification code we will send to you) for the purposes of enabling login by email or mobile phone number. If you choose to bind your phone number or email address with your account, you will have the option to login via your mobile phone number or email address and we will access your phone number or email address to verify you as a user without you having to enter a validation code or password every time you login. If you choose to bind your phone number, you can also enable two-factor authentication. Once enabled, we will verify additional data for authentication if you log in from a new device. If you choose to bind your email address, we will send an account security alert to your email address if we detect any suspicious activity. If you need to recover your account, we will ask you questions to verify your identity. If you would like to be featured on leaderboards, you will also be asked to bind your mobile phone number. For certain regions, we will ask you to bind your telephone number with your account when you change your location setting.

In addition, you may choose to provide your location (province and city) to use region-specific features, for example, our Battle Zone Leaderboard, People Nearby, Regional Chat Channel and birthday features. If you would like to use our birthday features, you may provide your birthday (month and day) and location. You may add your in-game weapon preferences, game mode preferences, voice chat preferences, audio self-introduction and any other information to your calling card and share your calling card and QR code with other players, if these functions are available in your region. You also provide us with information when you participate in a survey in the Game (in which case we will process the information you provide to us as part of the survey, which may include (amongst other information) your gender, age or age range, country or region of residence, income, education, occupation, contact information, nickname). If you participate in tournaments or e-sports events, we will use your user ID, nickname, battle videos and audio and video recordings during matches to validate that you are the correct Game user, to investigate any allegation of cheating and for marketing and promotion. In some instances, we may also take photos and videos of, and video record and livestream tournaments or Events that you participate in, in which case certain data relating to you or your team and videos of you will be processed, captured and displayed on public platforms. We may also retain photos and video recording of the tournament or Event for publicity and marketing purposes, and to improve our Game Services. If you are suspended from participating in tournaments or e-sports events for cheating or otherwise violating tournament or e-sports event rules, we use your name, Game nickname (including variations) and day and month of birth to enforce the suspension and may publish your nickname, the reason for the suspension and the duration on our Websites or social media channels. You also provide information when you interact with a Q&A function or with our customer service team, including your contact information, any questions and images you submit and your social media platform information. This FAQ explains some common questions on a feature for certain regions concerning chat of PLAYERUNKNOWN'S BATTLEGROUNDS MOBILE ("Game"), particularly for those users and prospective users who have questions about how we meet our requirements under data protection laws and other applicable regulations concerning data privacy.

For further information regarding our data privacy practices and this FAQ Please review the PLAYERUNKNOWN'S BATTLEGROUNDS MOBILE Privacy Policy, which sets out how we collect, store and process your personal data to provide you with the Game, and the End User License Agreement for PLAYERUNKNOWN'S BATTLEGROUNDS MOBILE.
For further information regarding our data privacy practices and this FAQ Please contact our privacy team via email at dpo@proximabeta.com should you have any further questions.
What is the in-game chat safety function?

To ensure the Game provides a safe platform for users of the Game, we have introduced an in-Game chat safety function ("Safety Feature") in certain regions. The Safety Feature helps us to improve your experience of the Game by flagging users who use chat function in violation of our End User License Agreement. For countries where the law requires that we have a legal basis for processing certain data, we operate the Safety Feature in our legitimate interests to ensure the safety and integrity of our Game. The Safety Feature works to identify, for example, unsolicited commercial communications, including plug-in sales and advertising, spam, harmful communication, exploits, bullying, harassment, threats of violence or conduct which is hateful, harassing, abusive, racially or ethnically offensive, defamatory, humiliating, threatening, profane or similarly objectionable ("Prohibited Conduct").
What are the consequences for users who engage in Prohibited Conduct?

All users are required to comply with our End User License Agreement, and you should familiarize yourself with your obligations as part of our gaming community. In order to ensure a safe gaming environment for our users we may take action against users who violate the End User License Agreement or otherwise engage in Prohibited Conduct, which may include limiting use of those features that have been abused.
How can I use the Safety Feature and how does it work?

When you observe a user engaging in Prohibited Conduct, you can press the "Report" button on the screen if this feature is available in your region. This will record a short snippet of the chat, and for voice chat, convert it into text at the same time or store the last 30 seconds of the voice chat on our servers. The chat data may be automatically translated if needed. The chat data will be reviewed for Prohibited Conduct and, in certain regions, for improvement of the tools we use to identify violations.
What if I think I have been implicated by mistake?
We have implemented safeguards to ensure any consequences are appropriate and proportionate to the relevant Prohibited Conduct and the frequency with which such Prohibited Conduct has occurred.

We will notify you if you have been muted or restricted from sending chats as a result of your breach of the End User License Agreement. If you think your use of the chat functions was restricted by mistake, please contact us at service@pubgmobile.com to request a review.
Do you warn users before taking action?
We may not issue a warning before restricting your use of the chat functions but we will notify you if restrictions are made.
Do you store chats and where do you store them?

The Safety Feature is designed to protect your privacy. Documented chat and the clip (for voice chat) is not stored, except where the information provides evidence of Prohibited Conduct by a user. In these cases we store the documented chat as evidence, and in certain regions we also store the documented chat and voice file in anonymized form for improvement of the tools we use to identify violations, on our servers in Singapore and subsequently automatically delete it in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
Do you disclose chats to any third parties?

We do not disclose any chats of any user to any third party, except where necessary for the review and translation process and to assist us in improving our anti-cheating tools, or in exceptional circumstances, such as where we believe we are legally required to (for example, if we are subject to a court order for disclosure), or where we need to do so in order to enforce or protect your rights, our rights or the rights of other users. Please consult our Privacy Policy for further details.
Can I object to your processing of my chats?

Yes. If you are a resident of a relevant country as noted in our Privacy Policy, you may have the right to object to, and seek restriction of, our processing of your chats for this purpose. To exercise your right, please contact us at dpo@proximabeta.com and please consult the Privacy Policy for further information.

We will consider several factors when assessing an objection, including: our users' reasonable expectations; the benefits and risks to you, us, or other users as a result of our implementation of the Safety Feature; and other available means to achieve the same purpose the Safety Feature achieves that may be less invasive and do not require disproportional effort. Unless the processing is based on our compelling legitimate grounds or is needed for legal reasons, your objection will be upheld and we will cease processing your information.
Is the Safety Feature secure and how do you comply with data protection laws?

We have a comprehensive global privacy program directed at protecting your personal data. You can read about how we process and protect personal data in our Privacy Policy. We also use a variety of security technologies and procedures for the purpose of preventing loss, misuse, unauthorized access or disclosure of your information.
How do you respond to law enforcement requests for chat information?

We may, from time to time, receive law enforcement requests to disclose your chat information (and its translation) to regulators, courts or law enforcement bodies. When we receive these requests, we take reasonable steps to query them and establish whether or not we are legally required to respond to them. When we are legally required to respond to such a request, we will take measures to safeguard your legal rights and your personal data.
